legend-slovenia-mangart-saddle-road.slogan: Slovenia Mangart Saddle Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-slovenia-mangart-saddle-road.story: curated scenic road. Julian Alps, exposed hairpins, panoramas. From Bovec it runs 15 km to Tarvisio; allow about 16 min of riding. The highest point is about 2,050 m. Passo del Predil and Mangart Saddle are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Slovenia Vrsic Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 10 km this is Slovenia Vrsic Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
